title: Disjoint sum of placements
statement: Let $k,l,m,n$ be natural numbers, and let one placement map the $k$ positions into the $l$ positions and another map the $m$ positions into the $n$ positions, each with its exact selector. Their disjoint sum is a placement from $k+m$ positions into $l+n$ positions: it uses the first placement on the first blocks and the second placement on the second blocks, with the corresponding selectors on those blocks.
hypotheses_covered: A placement from $k$ positions into $l$ positions
